About The Role
 In this role, you will lead quality assurance activities, define and implement testing strategies, and ensure the reliability and stability of a business-critical platform. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to establish effective testing processes, manage risks, and ensure high-quality releases.
 Responsibilities
Define and maintain the overall test strategy, test concepts, and quality governance framework for the platform
Design and execute risk-based test approaches focused on business-critical functionality and operational stability
Plan, coordinate, and oversee integration, end-to-end, regression, and acceptance testing activities
Develop and enhance automated testing solutions for UI, API, and system-level validation
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery and release quality
Establish and maintain quality gates, testing standards, and reporting processes across the delivery organization
Drive defect management, root-cause analysis, and quality improvement initiatives
Implement and manage test data strategies, mocking solutions, and test environment readiness
Collaborate with business, development, and operations teams to ensure alignment on quality objectives and release readiness
Provide transparent quality metrics, risk assessments, and go/no-go recommendations to project stakeholders
 Requirements
3-6 years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance, Test Management, or Test Automation
ISTQB Foundation Level certification and ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst certification (mandatory)
Proven experience in risk-based test design, test case optimization, and test case modelling
Strong practical experience with integration testing and end-to-end testing in complex environments
Hands-on experience working within Agile delivery organizations
Proven ability to design and implement test automation frameworks and automated testing solutions
Experience establishing quality gates, test governance processes, and quality reporting practices
Strong expertise in API testing and API test automation
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Practical knowledge of test data management and mocking technologies
Hands-on experience with Robot Framework, Playwright, Bruno, or comparable automation frameworks
Proficiency with Azure DevOps, Jira/Xray, and Git
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent stakeholder communication skills and the ability to bridge business, development, and operations teams
Upper-Intermediate or higher English proficiency
